molecule_name: Allogeneic NKG2DL-targeting CAR-grafted Gamma Delta T Cells

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: These are genetically engineered T cells designed to target and kill cancer cells expressing NKG2D ligands.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: The CAR-grafted gamma delta T cells recognize and bind to NKG2D ligands on tumor cells, leading to their activation and subsequent killing of the tumor cells.

typical_use.cancer: Various cancers including Colorectal Cancer, Triple Negative Breast Cancer, Sarcoma, Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma, Prostate Cancer, Gastric Cancer

data_notes.record_scope: The record is focused on the investigational cell therapy 'Allogeneic NKG2DL-targeting CAR-grafted Gamma Delta T Cells'.
